Name: Kenneth's Feast of Winter Star Secret Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]It's the Feast of the Winter Star... but this time, YOU'RE the one getting a secret gift![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Not from Santa Kenneth, but from your Secret Santas - the whole town! Every Winter 25, you'll get a special mail with gifts from the villagers themselves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this to feel like the actual Feast of the Winter Star event in-game. Abigail sent amethyst, Sebastian left frozen tears, Sam brought his favorite cactus fruit and pizza, Leah added goat cheese, Harvey brewed fresh coffee, and everyone pitched in![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]5x Amethyst, 5x Frozen Tear, 10x Cactus Fruit, 5x Pizza, 5x Goat Cheese, 10x Coffee, 5x Cloth, 10x Cookies, 5x Chocolate Cake, 2x Diamond, 2x Chest, 3x Golden Mystery Box, Stardrop Tea + 10k gold.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives Winter 25 yearly via mail - same day as Christmas Gift but different sender (villagers vs Santa)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Can be used together with Kenneth's Christmas Gift - you'll get 2 gifts on Winter 25![/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lore-friendly, balanced[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 1 version, cozy and heartfelt[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Your secret santas are waiting![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]
